Question

Have segments of this virus reassorted?

Detect whether a segmented virus, such as influenza, has exchanged genome segments with another strain.

Reassortment can only occur in viruses with segmented genomes, and it is detected by comparing the histories of individual segments.

Which protocol to use

If the pathogen is Viruses

  1. Viral phylogenomic surveillance

Build one tree per segment and compare where each sample falls. A sample that groups with different strains in different segment trees is a likely reassortant.
